assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps
assets.service: hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of P-4105

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.
Control HOT_WORK_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of hot work adjacent to live plant on P-4105 and TT-4105 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining hazardous-area electrical equipment, specifically inspecting Ex equipment and enclosures. P-4105 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was never verified as effective. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 13 February 2010 a hazard report was recorded on P-4105 and TT-4105 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
